map.在线按行过滤工具，按关键词包含/排除或正则匹配筛选多行文本，快速提取目标行、剔除: Online line filter that selects multi-line text by keyword include/exclude or regex matching, quickly pulling the target lines and dropping noise. Ideal for log analysis and data cleanup, processed entirely in your browser.
map.日志筛选：只保留含「ERROR」或排除「DEBUG」的行，聚焦问题。: Log filtering: keep only lines containing "ERROR" or exclude "DEBUG" lines to zero in on problems.
map.名单处理：按关键词包含/不包含过滤，得到目标子集。: List processing: filter by whether a keyword is present or absent to get the target subset.
map.数据预处理：过滤掉空行或特定前缀行，准备下游处理。: Data preprocessing: drop blank lines or lines with a given prefix before downstream processing.
map.：粘贴 5000 行日志，设「包含 ERROR」，输出仅 23 行错误；再叠加「: : paste 5000 log lines, set "contains ERROR", and you get just the 23 error lines; adding "exclude timeout" further removes known noise.
map.支持。简单子串与正则模式两种；复杂条件（如「A 且非 B」）可用正则或组合多次过: Yes. There are simple substring and regex modes; complex conditions (such as "A and not B") can be expressed with a regex or by chaining several filters.
map.默认敏感，可开忽略大小写；「error」与「ERROR」在敏感模式下是两条不同匹: Case-sensitive by default, with an option to ignore case; in sensitive mode "error" and "ERROR" are two different matches.
